messages.author: d5d4b8ce74f35ca7
messages.subject: leaflet Error in if (inline) "display: inline-block;" else "" : argument is not interpretable as log
parts:
I was trying to run this example code from here, https://rstudio.github.io/leaflet/shiny.html

  here is the code verbatim

library(shiny)
library(leaflet)

r_colors <- rgb(t(col2rgb(colors()) / 255))
names(r_colors) <- colors()

ui <- fluidPage(
  leafletOutput("mymap"),
  p(),
  actionButton("recalc", "New points")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  points <- eventReactive(input$recalc, {
    cbind(rnorm(40) * 2 + 13, rnorm(40) + 48)
  }, ignoreNULL = FALSE)
  
  output$mymap <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet() %>%
      addProviderTiles("Stamen.TonerLite",
        options = providerTileOptions(noWrap = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      addMarkers(data = points())
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)


this is the same problem as another user had, exactly and with the same code. They tried stackexchange and was told to report it in  2014 as a bug (apparently never did.

Someone said it was a bug with rgl,

They bailed on the problem because ith worked with a switch to R 3.2.3.

But I am already running 3.2.3. So it seams to be an intermittent bug!

At any rate, I get the error statement shown in the subject line above.

"
Error in if (inline) "display: inline-block;" else "" : 
  argument is not interpretable as logical  "

Can someone explain just what is going on so I can understandit? It does me know good to have it suddenly start to work whether spontaneously of with some blind fix. I need to understand why. Thanks

David

messages.subject: Re: leaflet Error in if (inline) "display: inline-block;" else "" : argument is not interpretable as log
parts: There was temporarily an incompatibility between the htmlwidgets library that leaflet depends on, and leaflet itself. We had made some changes to htmlwidgets that were supposed to be backwards compatible but turned out not to be. Can you try installing htmlwidgets from CRAN and leaflet from github (devtools::install_github("rstudio/leaflet")), then restarting R and trying again? Sorry for the inconvenience.
